title: BookMeEventEnvelope
description: Standard CloudEvents-aligned asynchronous message envelope for all BookMe domain events.

eventId.description: Globally unique identifier for this specific event occurrence.

type.description: Hierarchical domain event routing key (e.g. booking.requested, payment.deposit.succeeded).

version.description: Semantic schema version of the event payload.

occurredAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the event was generated.

correlationId.description: End-to-end tracing identifier initiated by the gateway or root request.

idempotencyKey.description: Deduplication key used by idempotent consumers.

producer.description: Identifier of the microservice producing this event.
